name: Mojo Dakedo, Gyaru ni Hensou Shitara Yuujin no Otto ni Namahame Sarechaimashita
original_name: 喪女だけど、ギャルに変装したら友人の夫に生ハメされちゃいました
source:
Chisato's friend Rinka asked her to find out if Rinka's husband was cheating. 
Chisato dressed up and flirted with him... and closed the loop of a self-fulfilling prophecy. 
She felt bad about screwing her best friend's husband, but she also felt sooo good......

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE168046.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
千里子的朋友凛花请她调查凛花的丈夫是否出轨。

千里子乔装打扮，向他卖弄风情……结果闭合了自我实现的预言。

她为和最好朋友的丈夫上床感到内疚，却又感觉棒极了……

[来源：[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE168046.html]DLsite英文版[/url]]
